liftMark.ar: أَسْتَيْقِظُ مُبَكِّرًا، بَيْنَمَا يَسْتَيْقِظُ أَخِي مُتَأَخِّرًا
liftMark.en: I wake up early, whereas my brother wakes up late
as for Saturday, it is the day of rest
I used to wake up late

liftMark.ar: أُحَضِّرُ حَقِيبَتِي حَتَّى لَا أَنْسَى كُتُبِي
liftMark.en: I prepare my bag so that I don’t forget my books

liftMark.ar: نَادِرًا مَا أَتَأَخَّرُ، وَلَا أَغِيبُ أَبَدًا
liftMark.en: I am rarely late, and I am never absent

liftMark.ar: لَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي وَقْتٌ، لَمَارَسْتُ الرِّيَاضَةَ
liftMark.en: if I had time, I would do sport
